data.one_liner: An animated jumping dot indicator widget for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable animated jumping dot indicator widget. Allows developers to configure the number of dots, color, radius, animation duration, inner padding, vertical offset, and delay.
use_when: You need a loading or waiting indicator with jumping dots
You want to customize dot indicator parameters like color, size, and animation speed
avoid_when: You require a complex chart or non-dot loading spinner
You need state-management or dependency-injection features
strengths: Customizable animation duration, delay, and vertical offset

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose shimmer if you prefer a skeleton loading effect over jumping dots.
